newsitem.title: UK: De La Rue rebounds after top-end results.
newsitem.headline: De La Rue rebounds after top-end results.

text.p: Shares in Britain's De La Rue Plc jumped higher on Tuesday as the banknote printer posted profits at the top end of analyst estimates and said there were signs that banknote printing prices were stabilising.
The stock was up 22-1/2p at 577-1/2 by 0839 GMT, after yesterday touching its lowest level since September 1992.
Pre-tax profits fell to 60.3 million stg in the six months ended September 30, down from 69.1 million stg a year before but towards the top end of forecasts of 55 to 61 million stg.
Chief executive Jeremy Marshall said the company was also beginning to see "considerable benefits arising from the reorganisations announced last year and from new products coming to market."
